top_signals.title: US Sees Iran War Oil Supply Disruptions Lasting Through 2027
top_signals.summary: The US now expects oil supply disruptions stemming from the US-Iran war to reach about 600,000 barrels per day through the end of next year as the conflict continues to crimp shipments via the critical Strait of Hormuz.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Emerging Assets Fall as Iran Hopes Fade and Oil Nears $90
top_signals.summary: Emerging-market assets extended losses on Tuesday, with most currencies weakening against the dollar and equities falling as Iran pushed back against earlier optimism over a potential deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, underscoring the fragility of sentiment around the conflict.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Uber Exits Serve Robotics Stake as Delivery Alliance Unravels
top_signals.summary: Uber Technologies Inc. has divested from long-time partner Serve Robotics Inc. as the two companies clash over how to deploy delivery robots, the latest setback in Uber’s push to facilitate autonomous services on its platform.
